question.en: What Benefits Do Dual-Eligible Medicare and MaineCare Enrollees Get in Maine (2026)?
question.es: ¿Qué Beneficios Reciben los Inscritos con Doble Elegibilidad de Medicare y MaineCare en Maine (2026)?

shortAnswer.en: It depends on your income tier: MaineCare pays Medicare costs three ways.
shortAnswer.es: Depende de su nivel de ingresos: MaineCare paga los costos de Medicare de tres formas.

fullAnswer.en: It depends on which Medicare Savings Program tier you qualify for. Mainers with both Medicare and MaineCare are called dual eligibles, and in 2026 MaineCare pays Medicare Part A and Part B premiums, deductibles, and coinsurance for Qualified Medicare Beneficiaries (QMB) earning up to 185% of the federal poverty level, while a second tier up to 250% FPL (the QI group) covers the Part B premium only. Full-benefit dual eligibles, typically aged or disabled Mainers with very low income, also receive MaineCare's complete benefit package, including long-term care, dental, and transportation, on top of Medicare.
fullAnswer.es: Depende del nivel del Programa de Ahorros de Medicare para el que califique. Los residentes de Maine con Medicare y MaineCare se llaman elegibles duales, y en 2026 MaineCare paga las primas, deducibles y coseguro de las Partes A y B de Medicare para los Beneficiarios Calificados de Medicare (QMB) con ingresos de hasta 185% del nivel federal de pobreza, mientras que un segundo nivel de hasta 250% FPL (el grupo QI) cubre solo la prima de la Parte B. Los elegibles duales de beneficio completo, típicamente residentes mayores o con discapacidades y muy bajos ingresos, también reciben el paquete completo de beneficios de MaineCare, incluyendo cuidado a largo plazo, dental y transporte, además de Medicare.

title.es: Beneficios de Doble Elegibilidad MaineCare en Maine 2026 | CoveredUSA

description.en: Dual eligible in Maine 2026: MaineCare income limits by household size, what QMB and QI cover, how to apply, and common denial reasons.
description.es: Doble elegibilidad en Maine 2026: límites de ingresos de MaineCare por tamaño del hogar, qué cubren QMB y QI, cómo solicitar y razones comunes de rechazo.

h1.en: Dual Eligible Medicare and MaineCare in Maine: What You Get (2026)
h1.es: Doble Elegibilidad de Medicare y MaineCare en Maine: Qué Obtiene (2026)

introParagraphs.en: Maine has one of the most generous Medicare Savings Program structures in the country. As of the July 2024 rule change, MaineCare removed the asset test for Medicare Savings Programs entirely and raised the income ceiling for the Qualified Medicare Beneficiary (QMB) group to 185% of the federal poverty level, with a second tier (QI) reaching 250% FPL. That means far more Mainers on Medicare qualify for help with premiums, deductibles, and coinsurance than the federal minimum requires.
introParagraphs.es: Maine tiene una de las estructuras de Programa de Ahorros de Medicare más generosas del país. A partir del cambio de reglas de julio de 2024, MaineCare eliminó por completo la prueba de activos para los Programas de Ahorros de Medicare y elevó el límite de ingresos para el grupo de Beneficiario Calificado de Medicare (QMB) a 185% del nivel federal de pobreza, con un segundo nivel (QI) que alcanza 250% FPL. Eso significa que muchos más residentes de Maine con Medicare califican para ayuda con primas, deducibles y coseguro de lo que exige el mínimo federal.

introParagraphs.en: Dual-eligible Mainers can use this guide to learn who counts as dual eligible in Maine, the 2026 MaineCare income limits by household size for the Medicare Savings Program, what each tier actually pays for, how to apply through My Maine Connection, and what to do if MaineCare denies your application. For the broader income picture, see [Medicaid income limits by state](/medicaid-income-limits) and the [2026 Federal Poverty Level chart](/federal-poverty-level).
introParagraphs.es: Esta guía cubre quién cuenta como elegible dual en Maine, los límites de ingresos de MaineCare 2026 por tamaño del hogar para el Programa de Ahorros de Medicare, qué paga realmente cada nivel, cómo solicitar a través de My Maine Connection, y qué hacer si MaineCare rechaza su solicitud.

paragraphs.en: It depends on income. In 2026, MaineCare's Qualified Medicare Beneficiary (QMB) tier covers Medicare Part A and Part B premiums, deductibles, and coinsurance for individuals earning up to $29,526 a year (185% FPL), while the Qualifying Individual (QI) tier, up to $39,900 a year (250% FPL), pays the Part B premium only. Full-benefit dual eligibles, usually aged or disabled Mainers on SSI, also get MaineCare's complete Medicaid benefit package alongside Medicare.
paragraphs.es: Depende de los ingresos. En 2026, el nivel de Beneficiario Calificado de Medicare (QMB) de MaineCare cubre las primas, deducibles y coseguro de las Partes A y B de Medicare para individuos con ingresos de hasta $29,526 al año (185% FPL), mientras que el nivel de Individuo Calificado (QI), hasta $39,900 al año (250% FPL), paga solo la prima de la Parte B.

heading.en: MaineCare Medicare Savings Program income limits by household size (2026)
heading.es: Límites de ingresos del Programa de Ahorros de Medicare de MaineCare por tamaño del hogar (2026)

paragraphs.en: MaineCare tests Medicare Savings Program eligibility by monthly countable income and family size, converted here to annual figures for comparison against the 2026 federal poverty guidelines. Maine no longer applies an asset test to either tier, a change made under 22 M.R.S. section 3174-LLL and rule MC-307A, effective July 1, 2024. That means bank accounts, retirement savings, and a second vehicle no longer block an otherwise-eligible Mainer from getting help with Medicare costs.
paragraphs.es: MaineCare evalúa la elegibilidad del Programa de Ahorros de Medicare por ingresos mensuales contables, convertidos aquí a cifras anuales para compararlos con las pautas federales de pobreza de 2026. Maine ya no aplica una prueba de activos a ninguno de los dos niveles, un cambio realizado bajo la sección 3174-LLL de 22 M.R.S. y la regla MC-307A, vigente desde el 1 de julio de 2024.

paragraphs.en: The table below shows the QMB threshold (185% FPL), the higher tier that pays Part A and B premiums plus deductibles and coinsurance. The QI threshold (250% FPL), which pays the Part B premium only, is listed in the notes column for each household size.
paragraphs.es: La tabla a continuación muestra el umbral QMB (185% FPL), el nivel más alto que paga las primas de las Partes A y B más deducibles y coseguro. El umbral QI (250% FPL), que paga solo la prima de la Parte B, se lista en la columna de notas para cada tamaño de hogar.

heading.en: What each MaineCare dual-eligible tier actually covers
heading.es: Qué cubre realmente cada nivel de doble elegibilidad de MaineCare

paragraphs.en: Maine sorts dual-eligible Medicare beneficiaries into three practical tiers, and the tier determines what MaineCare pays on top of Medicare. QMB is the broadest tier: it pays the Part B premium (standard $202.90 a month in 2026), the Part A premium if owed, the annual Part B deductible ($283 in 2026), and 20% Medicare coinsurance on doctor visits and outpatient care. QI pays only the Part B premium, which is still meaningful savings for a fixed-income household.
paragraphs.es: Maine clasifica a los beneficiarios de Medicare con doble elegibilidad en tres niveles prácticos, y el nivel determina qué paga MaineCare además de Medicare. QMB es el nivel más amplio: paga la prima de la Parte B (estándar de $202.90 al mes en 2026), la prima de la Parte A si se debe, el deducible anual de la Parte B ($283 en 2026) y el 20% de coseguro de Medicare en visitas médicas y atención ambulatoria. QI paga solo la prima de la Parte B.

paragraphs.en: Full-benefit dual eligibles, Mainers who qualify for both Medicare and complete MaineCare Medicaid coverage (usually through the SSI-linked aged, blind, or disabled pathway around $994 a month for an individual in 2026), get everything QMB provides plus MaineCare's own benefit package: nursing facility and home-based long-term care, adult dental, non-emergency medical transportation, and prescription drugs Medicare Part D does not fully cover. Every QMB and QI enrollee is also automatically enrolled in Part D Extra Help, the federal low-income drug subsidy, at no extra application step.

heading.en: How to apply for MaineCare Medicare Savings Program benefits
heading.es: Cómo solicitar los beneficios del Programa de Ahorros de Medicare de MaineCare

paragraphs.en: Maine's Office for Family Independence (OFI) processes MaineCare and Medicare Savings Program applications year-round; there is no enrollment window like Medicare's Annual Enrollment Period. The fastest path for most Mainers already on Medicare is applying online through My Maine Connection, the state's benefits portal, and indicating Medicare enrollment so OFI screens the application for QMB and QI automatically alongside regular MaineCare.
paragraphs.es: La Oficina para la Independencia Familiar (OFI) de Maine procesa las solicitudes de MaineCare y el Programa de Ahorros de Medicare todo el año; no hay una ventana de inscripción como el Período de Inscripción Anual de Medicare. El camino más rápido para la mayoría de los residentes de Maine que ya tienen Medicare es solicitar en línea a través de My Maine Connection.

list.en: Step 1: Gather your documents (see checklist below) before starting the application.
list.es: Paso 1: Reúna sus documentos (vea la lista abajo) antes de comenzar la solicitud.

list.en: Step 2: Apply online at mymaineconnection.gov, by phone through the OFI Eligibility Call Center at 1-855-797-4357, by mail or fax, or in person at a District Office.
list.es: Paso 2: Solicite en línea en mymaineconnection.gov, por teléfono a través del Centro de Llamadas de Elegibilidad de OFI al 1-855-797-4357, por correo o fax, o en persona en una Oficina de Distrito.

list.en: Step 3: Mark that you have Medicare Part A and/or Part B on the application so OFI screens for QMB and QI, not just standard MaineCare.
list.es: Paso 3: Marque que tiene la Parte A y/o Parte B de Medicare en la solicitud para que OFI evalúe QMB y QI, no solo MaineCare estándar.

list.en: Step 4: Respond to any verification requests (pay stubs, award letters) within 10 days to avoid a delay or denial.
list.es: Paso 4: Responda a cualquier solicitud de verificación (talones de pago, cartas de adjudicación) dentro de 10 días para evitar un retraso o rechazo.

list.en: Step 5: Wait for a determination letter. Approved Medicare Savings Program coverage can start the month after approval, and MaineCare can apply up to 3 months of retroactive coverage if you qualified earlier.
list.es: Paso 5: Espere la carta de determinación. La cobertura aprobada del Programa de Ahorros de Medicare puede comenzar el mes después de la aprobación, y MaineCare puede aplicar hasta 3 meses de cobertura retroactiva.

heading.es: Documentos necesarios para solicitar en Maine

paragraphs.en: Maine's Office for Family Independence asks for a short, specific set of documents to verify MaineCare dual-eligible status. Because the Medicare Savings Program asset test was eliminated in July 2024, applicants no longer need to report bank balances or vehicle values for QMB or QI, which shortens the list considerably compared to most other states.

heading.en: Is Maine a Medicaid expansion state?
heading.es: ¿Es Maine un estado de expansión de Medicaid?

paragraphs.en: Maine expanded Medicaid under the ACA in January 2019, after voters approved expansion by ballot referendum in 2017. That means MaineCare covers adults ages 19 to 64 with income up to 138% FPL through MAGI-based eligibility, separate from the Medicare Savings Program pathway described above, which applies only to Mainers already enrolled in Medicare and is not gated by MAGI. Dual eligibles do not use the 138% expansion pathway because Medicare enrollees are excluded from ACA expansion coverage by federal rule; instead, they qualify through QMB, QI, or the SSI-linked aged and disabled pathway.
paragraphs.es: Maine expandió Medicaid bajo el ACA en enero de 2019, después de que los votantes aprobaran la expansión mediante referéndum en 2017. Eso significa que MaineCare cubre a adultos de 19 a 64 años con ingresos de hasta 138% FPL a través de elegibilidad basada en MAGI, separada de la vía del Programa de Ahorros de Medicare descrita arriba, que se aplica solo a los residentes de Maine ya inscritos en Medicare.

paragraphs.en: The 10 states that have not expanded Medicaid (Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Kansas, Mississippi, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Wisconsin, and Wyoming) leave many low-income adults in the ACA coverage gap, too poor for marketplace subsidies but ineligible for traditional Medicaid. Maine's dual-eligible programs are unaffected by that gap because Medicare Savings Program eligibility runs on its own income rules, not the expansion pathway.

heading.en: Common reasons MaineCare dual-eligible applications get denied
heading.es: Razones comunes por las que se rechazan las solicitudes de doble elegibilidad de MaineCare

paragraphs.en: Most MaineCare Medicare Savings Program denials in Maine trace back to a small number of fixable problems. Knowing them ahead of time can shorten the process considerably.

list.en: Income above the QMB (185% FPL) or QI (250% FPL) threshold for the household size
list.es: Ingresos por encima del umbral QMB (185% FPL) o QI (250% FPL) para el tamaño del hogar

list.en: Not yet enrolled in both Medicare Part A and Part B, which the Medicare Savings Program requires
list.es: No estar inscrito aún en las Partes A y B de Medicare, requisito del Programa de Ahorros de Medicare

list.en: Missing or expired income verification documents
list.es: Documentos de verificación de ingresos faltantes o vencidos

list.en: Failure to respond to an OFI request within the 10-day verification deadline
list.es: No responder a una solicitud de OFI dentro del plazo de verificación de 10 días

list.en: Residency questions, most often for applicants who recently moved to Maine or split time between states
list.es: Preguntas de residencia, más comúnmente para solicitantes que se mudaron recientemente a Maine o dividen su tiempo entre estados

heading.en: How to appeal a MaineCare denial
heading.es: Cómo apelar un rechazo de MaineCare

paragraphs.en: Maine sends a written denial notice explaining the specific reason and the applicant's appeal rights. Mainers have 90 days from the date on the denial notice to request a fair hearing through the Office of Administrative Hearings, and benefits can continue during the appeal if the request is filed within 10 days of the notice date. Requests can be made by phone through the OFI Eligibility Call Center, in writing, or online through My Maine Connection, and free help is available from Maine Equal Justice and local Legal Services for the Elderly for Mainers over 60.

heading.en: MaineCare and Medicare together: the bigger picture
heading.es: MaineCare y Medicare juntos: el panorama general

paragraphs.en: MaineCare is the state's Medicaid program, administered by the Maine Department of Health and Human Services through the Office of MaineCare Services and the Office for Family Independence. Roughly 12 million Americans are dual eligible nationwide, and Maine's share skews older than the national average because of the state's high proportion of residents over 65. For dual eligibles, Medicare pays first for covered services (hospital care under Part A, outpatient and physician care under Part B, drugs under Part D), and MaineCare pays second, covering the premiums, deductibles, and coinsurance Medicare leaves behind, plus services Medicare does not cover at all.

Many Maine dual eligibles also qualify to enroll in a Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan (D-SNP), a type of Medicare Advantage plan built specifically for people with both Medicare and MaineCare. D-SNPs typically bundle Medicare and MaineCare benefits into one card, add extras like dental and over-the-counter allowances, and coordinate care between the two programs, though enrollment is optional; dual eligibles can also stay on Original Medicare with MaineCare wraparound coverage.

en.question: What does dual eligible mean in Maine?
en.answer: Dual eligible means a Mainer qualifies for both Medicare and MaineCare (Medicaid) at the same time. Medicare pays first for covered services, and MaineCare pays second, covering premiums, deductibles, coinsurance, or the full Medicaid benefit package depending on which tier you qualify for: QMB, QI, or full-benefit dual eligibility.

en.question: What is the income limit for QMB in Maine in 2026?
en.answer: The 2026 QMB income limit in Maine is $29,526 a year ($2,461 a month) for one person and $40,034 a year ($3,337 a month) for a two-person household, equal to 185% of the federal poverty level. Maine removed the asset test for this program in July 2024, so savings and property no longer count against eligibility.

en.question: What is the difference between QMB and QI in Maine?
en.answer: QMB (up to 185% FPL in 2026) pays the Medicare Part A and Part B premiums, the Part B deductible, and 20% Medicare coinsurance. QI (up to 250% FPL) pays only the Part B premium. Both tiers automatically enroll you in Part D Extra Help, the federal prescription drug subsidy, at no extra step.

en.question: Do I need to pass an asset test to get MaineCare Medicare Savings Program benefits?
en.answer: No. As of July 1, 2024, Maine eliminated the asset test for the Medicare Savings Program under state law 22 M.R.S. section 3174-LLL. Eligibility for QMB and QI is based on income alone, so bank accounts, retirement savings, and vehicles do not count against you.

en.question: How do I apply for dual-eligible benefits in Maine?
en.answer: Apply online at mymaineconnection.gov, by phone through the Office for Family Independence Eligibility Call Center at 1-855-797-4357, by mail or fax, or in person at a District Office. Mark that you have Medicare so OFI automatically screens the application for the Medicare Savings Program in addition to standard MaineCare.

en.question: Can I get MaineCare if my income is too high for QMB or QI?
en.answer: Possibly. Aged, blind, or disabled Mainers with income near the SSI federal benefit rate, about $994 a month for an individual in 2026, may qualify for full-benefit MaineCare in addition to Medicare. Maine also offers a medically needy spend-down pathway that lets you subtract medical expenses from countable income to qualify.

en.question: What happens if MaineCare denies my dual-eligible application?
en.answer: You have 90 days from the denial notice to request a fair hearing through Maine's Office of Administrative Hearings, and benefits can continue during the appeal if you request the hearing within 10 days of the notice. Free help is available from Maine Equal Justice and Legal Services for the Elderly for Mainers over 60.

en.question: Should a Maine dual eligible enroll in a D-SNP or stay on Original Medicare?
en.answer: Both are valid choices. A Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan (D-SNP) bundles Medicare and MaineCare benefits, often adds dental and over-the-counter allowances, and coordinates care through one plan. Staying on Original Medicare with MaineCare wraparound coverage keeps more provider flexibility. Compare specific D-SNP options available in your county before deciding.

es.question: ¿Qué significa doble elegibilidad en Maine?
es.answer: Doble elegibilidad significa que un residente de Maine califica para Medicare y MaineCare (Medicaid) al mismo tiempo. Medicare paga primero por los servicios cubiertos, y MaineCare paga segundo, cubriendo primas, deducibles, coseguro o el paquete completo de beneficios de Medicaid según el nivel para el que califique: QMB, QI o doble elegibilidad de beneficio completo.

es.question: ¿Cuál es el límite de ingresos para QMB en Maine en 2026?
es.answer: El límite de ingresos QMB de 2026 en Maine es $29,526 al año ($2,461 al mes) para una persona y $40,034 al año ($3,337 al mes) para un hogar de dos personas, igual al 185% del nivel federal de pobreza. Maine eliminó la prueba de activos para este programa en julio de 2024.

es.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre QMB y QI en Maine?
es.answer: QMB (hasta 185% FPL en 2026) paga las primas de las Partes A y B de Medicare, el deducible de la Parte B y el 20% de coseguro de Medicare. QI (hasta 250% FPL) paga solo la prima de la Parte B. Ambos niveles lo inscriben automáticamente en la Ayuda Adicional de la Parte D.

es.question: ¿Necesito pasar una prueba de activos para obtener los beneficios del Programa de Ahorros de Medicare de MaineCare?
es.answer: No. Desde el 1 de julio de 2024, Maine eliminó la prueba de activos para el Programa de Ahorros de Medicare bajo la ley estatal 22 M.R.S. sección 3174-LLL. La elegibilidad para QMB y QI se basa únicamente en los ingresos.

es.question: ¿Cómo solicito los beneficios de doble elegibilidad en Maine?
es.answer: Solicite en línea en mymaineconnection.gov, por teléfono a través del Centro de Llamadas de Elegibilidad de la Oficina para la Independencia Familiar al 1-855-797-4357, por correo o fax, o en persona en una Oficina de Distrito. Marque que tiene Medicare para que OFI evalúe automáticamente el Programa de Ahorros de Medicare.

es.question: ¿Puedo obtener MaineCare si mis ingresos son demasiado altos para QMB o QI?
es.answer: Posiblemente. Los residentes de Maine mayores, ciegos o con discapacidades con ingresos cercanos a la tasa federal de beneficio de SSI, aproximadamente $994 al mes para un individuo en 2026, pueden calificar para MaineCare de beneficio completo además de Medicare. Maine también ofrece una vía de reducción médicamente necesaria.

es.question: ¿Qué pasa si MaineCare rechaza mi solicitud de doble elegibilidad?
es.answer: Tiene 90 días desde el aviso de rechazo para solicitar una audiencia justa a través de la Oficina de Audiencias Administrativas de Maine, y los beneficios pueden continuar durante la apelación si solicita la audiencia dentro de 10 días del aviso. Hay ayuda gratuita disponible de Maine Equal Justice.

es.question: ¿Debería un elegible dual de Maine inscribirse en un D-SNP o quedarse con Medicare Original?
es.answer: Ambas son opciones válidas. Un Plan de Necesidades Especiales de Doble Elegibilidad (D-SNP) combina los beneficios de Medicare y MaineCare, a menudo agrega asignaciones dentales y de venta libre, y coordina la atención en un solo plan. Quedarse con Medicare Original con cobertura complementaria de MaineCare mantiene más flexibilidad de proveedores.

commonDenialReasons.en: Missing or expired income verification documents
commonDenialReasons.es: Documentos de verificación de ingresos faltantes o vencidos

commonDenialReasons.en: Failure to respond to an OFI verification request within 10 days
commonDenialReasons.es: No responder a una solicitud de verificación de OFI dentro de 10 días

deadline.en: Year-round; MaineCare and the Medicare Savings Program have no open enrollment window
deadline.es: Todo el año; MaineCare y el Programa de Ahorros de Medicare no tienen ventana de inscripción abierta
